request: RFC 952 hostname validation must reject a hostname whose last label ends with a hyphen, while still accepting valid hostnames such as test.example.com and single-label names.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: reject hostnames with trailing hyphen in RFC 952 validator (#1569)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
